WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
        COUNT(*) AS fielding_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        batting_hand,
        fielding_count,
        1.0 * fielding_count / SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
        AVG(fielding_count) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT
    batting_hand,
    fielding_count,
    share_of_total,
    fielding_count - average_count AS above_average
FROM summary
WHERE fielding_count > average_count
ORDER BY batting_hand;

assumptions.assumption: Counts each row in fielding as one fielding record, and groups both blank strings and NULL batting hands together as an empty hand value. The average is the unweighted average of the hand-group counts.
